queryName: Beta - Production Workload using Basic or Consumption SKU
descriptionText: Detects Azure Service Plans and API Management instances using tiers unsuitable for production. Flagged azurerm_service_plan SKUs: B1/B2/B3 (Basic — no SLA, limited scale-out), F1/FREE (Free — no SLA, no custom domains), Y1 (Consumption — cold-start latency, no always-on). Flagged azurerm_api_management SKUs: Basic and Consumption (no VNet integration, no built-in cache, no multi-region deployment). Standard, Premium, or Isolated SKUs are recommended for production workloads.
